scriptLines: query: 'SELECT CAST(YEAR(f.d)*10000+MONTH(f.d)*100+DAY(f.d) AS INT) AS fecha_key, f.d AS fecha_completa, CAST(YEAR(f.d) AS SMALLINT) AS anio, CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER,f.d) AS SMALLINT) AS trimestre, \'T\'+CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER,f.d) AS VARCHAR(1)) AS trimestre_nombre, CAST(MONTH(f.d) AS SMALLINT) AS mes, CHOOSE(MONTH(f.d),\'Enero\',\'Febrero\',\'Marzo\',\'Abril\',\'Mayo\',\'Junio\',\'Julio\',\'Agosto\',\'Septiembre\',\'Octubre\',\'Noviembre\',\'Diciembre\') AS mes_nombre, CHOOSE(MONTH(f.d),\'Ene\',\'Feb\',\'Mar\',\'Abr\',\'May\',\'Jun\',\'Jul\',\'Ago\',\'Sep\',\'Oct\',\'Nov\',\'Dic\') AS mes_corto, CAST(DATEPART(ISO_WEEK,f.d) AS SMALLINT) AS semana_anio, CAST(DAY(f.d) AS SMALLINT) AS dia_mes, CAST(w.dow AS SMALLINT) AS dia_semana, CHOOSE(w.dow,\'Lunes\',\'Martes\',\'Miércoles\',\'Jueves\',\'Viernes\',\'Sábado\',\'Domingo\') AS dia_nombre, CAST(CASE WHEN w.dow IN (6,7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS es_fin_de_semana FROM (SELECT DATEADD(DAY, n.n, r.ini) AS d FROM (SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(MIN(x)),1,1) AS ini, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(MAX(x)),12,31) AS fin FROM (SELECT admission_date AS x FROM silver.admissions UNION ALL SELECT discharge_date FROM silver.admissions UNION ALL SELECT payment_date FROM silver.billing) u WHERE x IS NOT NULL) r CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP (DATEDIFF(DAY,r.ini,r.fin)+1) CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL))-1 AS INT) AS n FROM sys.all_objects a CROSS JOIN sys.all_objects b) n) f CROSS APPLY (SELECT (DATEDIFF(DAY,\'19000101\',f.d)%7)+1 AS dow) w',
preSQLs:['DELETE FROM gold.fact_facturacion','DELETE FROM gold.fact_admisiones','DELETE FROM gold.dim_fecha'],
